faq_items.question: What size should I print boho arch wall art?
faq_items.answer: Print to a standard frame size so you skip custom framing. The 8x10 in and 11x14 in sizes suit shelves and bedrooms, while 16x20 in works as a living room focal point. Buy the frame first, then print the art at 100 percent scale to fit it.

faq_items.question: What paper is best for printing wall art at home?
faq_items.answer: For a matte gallery look, use 32 lb bright white paper or a light cardstock. For richer, deeper color in the terracotta and sage tones, matte photo paper works beautifully. Always print one test page first to check color and centering before using your good paper.

faq_items.question: Is boho arch wall art really free to download?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The print-ready PDF downloads free with no email required. Print as many copies as you want at home or at a print shop, in any standard frame size. It is for personal home use, so you can frame it for any room or gift it.

faq_items.question: What colors go with boho arch prints?
faq_items.answer: Boho arch prints pair best with warm, earthy tones and natural textures. Echo one color from the print, terracotta, ochre, clay, or sage, in a throw, basket, or rug, and keep walls neutral. Rattan, linen, jute, and aged wood all complement the grounded, bohemian palette.

faq_items.question: How do you hang a set of arch prints straight?
faq_items.answer: Lay the prints on the floor and arrange the layout first, then snap a photo to copy. Hang the center of the group at 57 to 60 inches from the floor, keep 2-3 inches between frames, and use a level. Reusable adhesive strips let you adjust spacing without extra holes.
